replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics is my favorite subject to explore but not my strongest area. replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, especially when the problems get complex or I feel stuck. My high neuroticism score makes me prone to stress, but I manage by breaking problems into smaller steps and using mindfulness techniques to stay calm.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used an AI tool like ChatGPT to check my solutions and get explanations. It helped me understand mistakes quickly, but sometimes the explanations were too technical for my level. I appreciate the clarity but need more simplified guidance.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form: ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac). If it's positive, you get two real solutions; if zero, one real solution; if negative, two complex solutions. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(discriminant)] / (2a).

To find stationary points, take the first derivative of the function f'(x). Set f'(x) = 0 and solve for x. Plug these x-values back into f(x) to find the corresponding y-values. These points are where the slope of the function is zero, indicating potential maxima or minima.
